def build_other_options_msg(fix_version: Optional[str], is_spec: bool,
    secure_options: List[str]) ->str:
    if len(secure_options) == 1:
        return f'Other version without known vulnerabilities is {secure_options[0]}'
    else:
        return f'Other versions without known vulnerabilities are: {", ".join(secure_options)}'


def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    if not kwargs:
        kwargs = {}

    section = []
    sep = '+' + '=' * (columns - 2) + '+'

    section.append('   REMEDIATIONS')

    if not is_using_api_key():
        rem_count = sum(len(v) for v in remediations.values())
        vuln_count = sum(r.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0) for pkg_rems in remediations.values() for r in pkg_rems.values())
        pkg_count = len(remediations)
        content = f'\n  {vuln_count} vulnerabilit{"y" if vuln_count == 1 else "ies"} was reported in {pkg_count} package. For detailed remediation & fix \n  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. \n'
        section.append(content)
    else:
        for pkg_name, pkg_rems in remediations.items():
            for spec, rem in pkg_rems.items():
                version = rem.get('version', '')
                vulns_found = rem.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
                recommended_version = rem.get('recommended_version', None)
                closest = rem.get('closest_secure_version', {})
                other_recommended = rem.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
                more_info_url = rem.get('more_info_url', '')

                closest_upper = closest.get('upper', None) or closest.get('major', None)

                content = f'\n-> {pkg_name} version {version} was found, which has {vulns_found} vulnerabilit{"y" if vulns_found == 1 else "ies"}\n'

                if closest_upper:
                    content += f'   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {closest_upper}\n'

                content += f'{" " * (columns - 2)}\n'

                if recommended_version:
                    rec_msg = f'   We recommend updating to version {recommended_version} of {pkg_name}.'
                    if other_recommended:
                        other_str = ', '.join(str(v) for v in other_recommended)
                        rec_msg += f' Other versions\n   without known vulnerabilities are: {other_str}\n'
                    else:
                        rec_msg += '\n'
                    content += rec_msg

                content += f'{" " * (columns - 2)}\n'

                if more_info_url:
                    content += f'   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit\n'
                    content += f'   {more_info_url}\n'
                    content += f'   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.\n'

                content += f'{" " * (columns - 2)}'

                section.append(content)

    section.append(sep)

    return section


def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    available_width = columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)

    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=available_width,
        initial_indent=indent,
        subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False,
    )

    wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text) if text.strip() else ['']

    if max_lines is not None and len(wrapped_lines) > max_lines:
        wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]

    result_lines = []
    for line in wrapped_lines:
        padded = start_line_decorator + line + end_line_decorator
        if color:
            padded = click.style(padded, fg=color)
        result_lines.append(padded)

    return '\n'.join(result_lines)
